label: Background A with 5 independently derived clones per genotype state
units: log2 normalised reporter intensity (TMT, internal reference scaled)
missing_value: empty cell = protein not detected in that run (never imputed)
notes: 25 clones, 50 runs, 23 residual degrees of freedom. The fully replicated version: lambda and the editing-noise floor are estimated from twenty artefact contrasts, and the permutation null is large enough that the global p-value is not floor-limited.
planted_truth: Same planted effects as background A.

column_documentation.library: unique id of one MS run; must match a column of intensities.tsv
column_documentation.clone: clonal isolate the run came from -- THE UNIT OF REPLICATION
column_documentation.state: genotype label, e.g. wild_type / het_edit / hom_revertant
column_documentation.dose: number of mutant alleles carried by the clone: 0, 1 or 2
column_documentation.lineage: editing event the clone descends from; siblings share off-targets
column_documentation.tech_rep: replicate index within the clone (separate digest + injection)
column_documentation.plex: TMT plex / acquisition batch, fitted as a blocking factor
